paper_title: Can LLMs Solve longer Math Word Problems Better
caption: : Informativeness and missing step values of 4 representative LLMs
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the relationship between an unspecified variable on the x-axis and the "Missing Step" value on the y-axis for two models, 0-CoT and CoRe. The x-axis is labeled with values ranging from 0 to 4, with a linear scale and no specified units; tick labels are numeric and regularly spaced at intervals of 1. The y-axis is labeled "Missing Step" with values from 0.835 to 0.850, also on a linear scale; tick labels are numeric and regularly spaced at intervals of 0.005. The 0-CoT line starts at approximately (0, 0.848) with a blue dashed line and circular markers, decreasing to around (4, 0.836). The CoRe line starts at approximately (0, 0.854) with an orange solid line and triangular markers, decreasing to around (4, 0.838).
